string.text: Default 30 seconds. The first wave appears when combat starts, then reinforcements arrive at this interval, subject to active-wave and remaining-force limits. Applies to the next coup.
Default 30. Maximum defenders spawned per wave in the street and hall; limited by remaining defenders and never created from nothing. Applies to the next coup.
Launch an armed coup in the town where your kingdom's ruler resides. Disabling prevents new coups; ongoing battles finish safely. Troop and reinforcement settings apply to the next coup.
Default 10. Assigned from healthy defenders; fewer are used when unavailable. The hall can be attacked after the gate guards are cleared. Applies to the next coup.
Default 20, excluding the ruler. Assigned first from healthy defenders; remaining troops are assigned to gate and street guards. Applies to the next coup.
Default 20, excluding the player. Selected only from street survivors. Applies to the next coup; larger parties may crowd the hall.
Default 4 waves. A wave occupies a slot while any defender remains alive; reinforcements wait for an open slot. Applies to the next coup.
Default 4; 0 means unrestricted. Applies only to new coups and is checked again when troops are confirmed.
Default 300; 0 means unrestricted. Checked but not spent. The threshold is fixed when the confirmation window opens and checked again when troops are confirmed.

Default 60 healthy regular soldiers must be selected, with one additional person left as a reserve. The player, heroes, and wounded do not count. Cannot exceed the street limit; the hall requires at least one survivor regardless of this threshold.
Default 60, excluding the player. Healthy regular soldiers only, with at least one reserve. Applies to the next coup; larger parties increase scene load.
